Yes — let's take those one at a time, in order, since Airplane Mode can affect what the other checks report.

**Step 1: Turn Airplane Mode OFF**
On your phone, go to Settings and toggle **Airplane Mode OFF** (or use the quick-settings tile in the notification shade). This is the first thing to fix, because while it's on it disables all wireless radios — cellular, Wi-Fi, and Bluetooth — so nothing else can connect.

Once it's off, check your **network/SIM status** again and tell me what it shows.

**Step 2 (only if the SIM still shows "missing"): Reseat the SIM card**
A "missing" SIM usually just means it isn't seated properly. Power the phone off, remove the SIM tray, take the SIM card out, wipe it gently, reinsert it firmly, and put the tray back in. Then power the phone back on.

After both steps, let me know what the status bar and network status show — specifically whether you now have signal bars and whether mobile data is enabled. Once we confirm you have service and mobile data, we'll re-check whether MMS can send.

One thing to flag up front: if after reseating the SIM it instead reports **"Locked"** (PIN/PUK), don't keep trying codes — that's something I'll need to escalate to our technical support team for you.
